title: Implement ATT-01/#3: persist mutable current approval/input attention from canonical orchestration events alongside the unchanged immutable audit. Provide opaque request-scoped identity, revisions, bounded reason codes, independent replay cursor and atomic projection updates; support restart/rebuild/deletion without phantom requests. No RPC, UI, notifications, client cursors or failure/disconnect heuristics.

rejection.note: Maintainer explicitly approved ATT-01 ownership in the existing phase1-foundation maintenance root; retain this unimplemented request as history instead of a second overlapping active root.
